question_text: Explain how fitness evaluation influences selection in a genetic algorithm for efficient delivery routes.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: A fitness function scores each route against the chosen objective, e.g.shorter valid routes.; Selection uses those scores to favour suitable routes as parents.; Recombination/mutation of selected candidates explores new routes while biasing the search toward fitter solutions.
